      "what": "Stepper and tab polish.",
      "where": "workflow-768.png: the workflow cards and the two stacked tab bars. Leaderboard-375-top.png: the wrapped tabs.",

Style the dataset tabs differently, as segmented pills or under a section heading. At 375, make the view tabs one horizontally scrollable row with scroll-snap and an edge fade."
